summary: A family of two whose caller said one of them may run at once, and one warm machine to run them on. The first member takes the family's place and the machine refuses its launch, which is a thing no other Blueprint in this corpus does to a member of a family. The Booking is given back in the same commit as the failure, so the family has room again and the second member is admitted onto the machine its sibling gave back, runs, and finishes. The first member ends failed: the only machine in this world is the snapshot that refused it, Mercator will not offer it that snapshot again, and a replacement with nowhere to go closes the Run. That a family which lost a member to a launch failure still drains is the claim, and that one member held capacity at a time throughout is the other. What this cannot tell apart is which recorded fact took the first member out of its family's count. The Booking going back with the failure and the Run closing land in the same pass here, so counting either one admits the sibling, and the moment between them is stated where it can be held still, in TestAMemberThatGaveItsCapacityBackLeavesRoomForItsFamily.
